key_facts: The park hosts 17 different bat species.
They typically roost in a different part of the cavern and fly about 1.5 miles (2.4 km) before exiting the Natural Entrance
The Brazilian free-tailed bats weigh about 1/2 ounce (13 g), which is equivalent to the weight of three nickel coins
the resident colony should not be called the maternity colony because it is typically greater than 50% male
WNS has already taken the lives of an estimated 7+ million bats in the United States
adding up to more than $3.7 billion worth of pest control each year in the U.S.
Researchers first discovered the disease in New York in the winter of 2006
WNS has killed 99% of some bat colonies
Tree-roosting and migratory bats face significant threats from wind turbines

forbidden_claims.claim: The park hosts 42 different bat species, the most of any site in the region.
Researchers believe White-nose Syndrome originated in Texas during the winter of 2006.
The resident colony at Carlsbad Cavern excludes males entirely during the summer months.

notes: Sample article for the Space demo (role: sample-article). The 50%-male fact is a reversal trap: this colony is explicitly NOT female-dominated, unlike most large colonies outside the park.
